title: Failure Profiling and Reachable Trajectory Selection for Reasoning Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.09042v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training smaller language models on reasoning solutions generated by a larger teacher model is the prevailing approach for transferring mathematical reasoning capabilities. However, the student tends to overfit the output distribution of the teacher and generalizes poorly when its own behavior at inference time deviates from the training data. Recent methods attempt to bridge this gap by incorporating error data, yet the corrective trajectories still reflect the reasoning patterns of the teacher, which the student cannot reliably reproduce, leaving the distribution mismatch largely unresolved. We propose a method, Failure Profiling and Reachable Trajectory Selection (FPRT), built on the insight that effective training data should be jointly determined by what the student fails on and what it can realistically learn. Our method first profiles the failure behavior of the student on each problem through repeated sampling, characterizing it

translated_title: 推理蒸馏中的失败画像与可达轨迹选择
translated_abstract: 用较大教师模型生成的推理解法来训练较小的语言模型，是目前迁移数学推理能力的主流方法。然而，学生模型往往会过拟合教师模型的输出分布，当其在推理阶段自身的行为偏离训练数据时，泛化能力表现很差。近期的方法试图通过引入错误数据来弥合这一差距，但这些纠正轨迹仍然反映的是教师模型的推理模式，而学生模型无法可靠地复现这些模式，导致分布不匹配问题在很大程度上仍未得到解决。我们提出了一种名为“失败画像与可达轨迹选择”（FPRT）的方法，该方法基于这样一个洞察：有效的训练数据应当由“学生在哪些方面失败”和“学生能够切实学到什么”这两方面共同决定。我们的方法首先通过重复采样来刻画学生模型在每个问题上的失败行为，并对其进行表征……
tldr: 提出FPRT方法，通过重复采样刻画学生模型的失败行为并筛选其“可学习”的训练轨迹，使蒸馏训练数据同时兼顾学生失败点与实际可达能力，从而缓解师生分布不匹配导致的泛化差问题。
en_tdlr: FPRT selects distillation training trajectories by jointly profiling what the student model fails on and what it can realistically learn, resolving the teacher-student distribution mismatch that causes poor generalization.
